newsitem.title: USA: Lucent sees $950 mln Octel "charge" in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Lucent sees $950 mln Octel "charge" in Q4.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc estimated a $950 million one-time charge against fourth quarter earnings related to its planned acquisition of Octel Communications Corp, a regulatory filing said.

In a quarterly filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission released Wednesday, Lucent said it anticipates the charge, expected in the fourth quarter ending September 30, would be allocated to in-process research and development.
Lucent, based in Murray Hill, N.J., posted third quarter earnings of $213 million or $0.33 a share with sales at $6.3 billion.

When the deal was first announced in mid-July, Lucent had said it would result in a one-time, non-cash charge against earnings and have a significant effect on net earnings for Q4 fiscal 1997 and net earnings for the fiscal year ending 1997.
The balance of the $1.8 billion purchase price would be allocated to tangible assets, acquired technology and goodwill and less liabilities, Lucent said in the filing.
Based on current estimates, Lucent said it anticipates goodwill and acquired technology to be about $400, which would be amortized over periods not exceeding seven years.
Lucent moved to buy Octel in a bid to beef up its voice mail, fax and messaging business in the United States and abroad.

Under the deal, Lucent would pay $31 per share. The tender offer is scheduled to expire on August 29, and is subject to a number of conditions. If necessary, Lucent said it would extend the tender offer as appropriate.
